headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Ambuja Cements Limited announced the outcome and proceedings of its NCLT-convened General Meeting held on September 28, 2026. The company also submitted the Scrutinizer's report and voting results to the Exchange.

headline: General Updates
summary: GFL Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal has issued its order regarding the scheme of merger by absorption of INOX Infrastructure Limited into GFL Limited.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Orient Cement Limited announced the outcome and proceedings of its NCLT-convened General Meeting held on September 28, 2026. The company also submitted the Scrutinizer's report and voting results to the Exchange.

headline: General Updates
summary: Go Digit General Insurance Limited has scheduled a meeting of its Equity Shareholders for Thursday, 5th November 2026, at 11:00 A.M. (IST) via video conferencing/audio-visual means. Remote e-voting will be available from 1st November 2026 to 4th November 2026, with the cut-off date for determining voting eligibility set as 29th October 2026. The meeting notice and related documents are accessible on the Company's website and stock exchange platforms.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Go Digit General Insurance Limited has scheduled a meeting of its Equity Shareholders for Thursday, 5th November 2026, at 11:00 A.M. IST, to be held via video conferencing/audio-visual means. Remote e-voting will be available from 1st November 2026 to 4th November 2026, with the cut-off date for determining eligible shareholders being 29th October 2026.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: JSW Cement Limited's board approved a Scheme of Arrangement on September 29, 2026, involving the transfer of Shiva Cement Limited (the Transferor Company) to JSW Cement Limited (the Transferee Company). The scheme remains subject to approval by JSW Cement's shareholders.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: TPL Plastech Limited's Board has approved a scheme of amalgamation whereby the company will merge into its 74.86% parent, Time Technoplast Limited (TTL), effective April 1, 2026, subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals. Under the share exchange ratio, TPL shareholders (other than TTL) will receive 403 fully paid-up equity shares of TTL for every 1,000 equity shares held in TPL.

headline: Updates
summary: Bluspring Enterprises Limited announced a proposed scheme of amalgamation involving Bluspring New Horizon Two Private Limited (the transferor company) and LSG Sky Chefs India Private Limited (the transferee company). The company informed the Exchange of the proposed merger.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: MPS Limited announced that it has published newspaper notices regarding the hearing of the Second Motion Petition for the Scheme of Amalgamation between ADI BPO Services Limited (Transferor Company) and MPS Limited (Transferee Company). The notices appeared in Business Standard (all English editions) and Dina Malar (Chennai Tamil edition) on 29 September 2026, as directed by the National Company Law Tribunal, Chennai Bench.

headline: General Updates
summary: GSPL Transmission Limited has received final listing and trading approval from BSE and NSE for 31,27,43,617 equity shares of ₹10 each, issued to Gujarat Energy Limited shareholders under the Scheme of Arrangement. The shares will be listed and admitted for trading with effect from 30th September, 2026.

headline: Press Release
summary: JSW Cement's board approved a Scheme of Arrangement at its September 29, 2026 meeting, continuing from its earlier disclosure of the same date. The company issued a press release detailing the outcome of that board meeting.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Time Technoplast Limited announced that its scheme of amalgamation, involving the merger by absorption of TPL Plastech Limited into Time Technoplast Limited, has been approved. The scheme also covers the respective shareholders and creditors of both companies.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Ambuja Cements Limited announced the outcome of its NCLT-convened general meeting held on September 29, 2026, regarding the Scheme of Amalgamation of ACC Limited with the company. The company also submitted the Scrutinizer's report and voting results to the Exchange.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Go Digit General Insurance Limited has notified the Exchange of a newspaper publication regarding a notice convening a meeting of its equity shareholders. The meeting is being held pursuant to an order from the Hon'ble NCLT.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: ACC Limited held an NCLT-convened general meeting on September 29, 2026, and has informed the Exchange of its outcome and proceedings. The company also submitted the Scrutinizer's report along with the voting results to the Exchange.

headline: News Verification
summary: Sun TV Network Limited has not yet responded to a stock exchange query regarding a news report about a possible demerger of its sports division. The clarification was sought following the recent news item, and the company's response is still awaited.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Asian Energy Services Limited announced that the NCLT Mumbai Bench has pronounced its order approving the Scheme of Merger by Absorption of Oilmax Energy Private Limited into Asian Energy Services Limited. The scheme also covers the respective shareholders of both companies.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: PPAP Automotive Limited held separate meetings of its equity shareholders, secured creditors, and unsecured creditors to consider the Scheme of Amalgamation of Avinya Batteries Limited with itself. The meetings were convened pursuant to an NCLT order as part of the approval process for the merger.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Ambuja Cements Limited has submitted the Combined Scrutinizer's Report to the Exchange regarding the NCLT-convened meeting of its equity shareholders. The meeting was held pursuant to an order from the NCLT Ahmedabad Bench concerning the Scheme of Amalgamation of ACC Limited with Ambuja Cements.

headline: Updates
summary: GSPL Transmission Limited announced that its equity shares commenced trading on the BSE and NSE on September 30, 2026, completing the GSPC Group Scheme of Arrangement under which the gas transmission business of erstwhile Gujarat State Petronet Limited was demerged into it. The company operates approximately 2,900 km of natural gas transmission pipelines across 26 districts in Gujarat, making it India's second-largest gas transmission company, with plans to add 711 km of pipelines.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Sammaan Capital Limited has published newspaper advertisements regarding a proposed Scheme of Arrangement between itself (the Resulting Company) and Sammaan Finserve Limited (the Demerged Company). The notices, published on September 30, 2026 in the Financial Express and Jansatta, comply with a National Company Law Tribunal order dated September 21, 2026 concerning the Second Motion Petition for the demerger.

headline: News Verification
summary: Sun TV Network Limited responded to a stock exchange clarification request regarding a news report about a possible demerger of its sports division. The company's response is attached to the announcement.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited announced that the NCLT Bengaluru Bench has sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation concerning SPC International (India) Private Limited, the Fourth Transferor Company, by order dated September 30, 2026. This follows the earlier sanction by the NCLT Chennai Bench, completing all required judicial approvals for the merger of five transferor companies into TVS Supply Chain Solutions. The Scheme will become effective upon filing of certified copies of both orders with the jurisdictional Registrar of Companies, with effect from the Appointed Date.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) Mumbai Bench has dismissed the proposed amalgamation between Madhya Bharat Phosphate Private Limited and Kisan Phosphates Private Limited, both wholly-owned subsidiaries of Shree Pushkar Chemicals & Fertilisers Limited, after the applicant withdrew the scheme for commercial reasons. The withdrawal order, dated September 21, 2026, was made available on the NCLT website on September 30, 2026.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: BCPL Railway Infrastructure Limited has incorporated a wholly owned subsidiary named AJU Real Estate Private Limited, with the certificate of incorporation issued by the Ministry of Corporate Affairs on September 30, 2026. The company disclosed this development to the Exchange under "Other Restructuring."

headline: General Updates
summary: GE Power India Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) has sanctioned its Scheme via an order dated October 1, 2026, with the sanctioned order now available on the NCLT and company websites. The company is awaiting a certified true copy of the order and will notify the stock exchanges of the Effective Date and Record Date in due course.

headline: General Updates
summary: JSW Energy Limited has received a copy of the order sanctioning the Scheme of Arrangement between GE Power India Limited (the demerged company) and JSW Energy Limited (the resulting company) and their respective shareholders. The scheme was approved under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Tata Steel Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench, has approved and sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation between Tata Steel Limited and Rujuvalika Investments Limited, along with their respective shareholders.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Tata Steel Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench, has approved and sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation between Tata Steel Limited and Rujuvalika Investments Limited, along with their respective shareholders.

headline: Demerger
summary: Sunteck Realty Limited's Board has approved a scheme of arrangement to demerge the "Sunteck City 4th Avenue Undertaking" from its wholly owned subsidiary, Satguru Corporate Services Private Limited, into Sunteck on a going concern basis. The demerged undertaking contributed approximately Rs. 869 crore in turnover (~77% of Sunteck's consolidated turnover for FY2026), and the scheme is an internal reorganisation aimed at operational efficiencies and efficient resource pooling. The scheme is subject to statutory and regulatory approvals, including the NCLT, and will result in no change in shareholding patterns or new share issuance.

headline: Sale or disposal
summary: AXISCADES Technologies Limited announced the completion of the transfer of its Engineering Services business in Heavy Engineering, Automotive, and Energy to Akkodis entities, effective October 1, 2026, following the satisfaction of conditions precedent on September 30, 2026. The company and its subsidiaries also executed an Amendment Agreement revising certain commercial and operational terms of the original Transaction Documents, including foreign exchange reference dates and payment/holdback arrangements, without altering the overall transaction value.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Amber Enterprises India Limited announced that it has received an NCLT order dated September 25, 2026 (received October 1, 2026) approving the Scheme of Amalgamation of AmberPR Technoplast India Private Limited into the Company. The order was passed in connection with CP(CAA) No. 18/Chd/Pb/2026 and CA(CAA) No. 11/Chd/Pb/2026, as disclosed under SEBI LODR Regulations.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: K.M. Sugar Mills Limited announced that its Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of its Distillery Division into KM Spirits and Allied Industries Limited has become effective as of October 1, 2026. The company confirmed that both entities have filed the certified NCLT order with the Registrar of Companies, Uttar Pradesh.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Wipro Limited announced the completed merger of its step-down subsidiary Wipro VLSI Design Services, LLC into fellow step-down subsidiary Wipro IT Services, LLC, effective October 1, 2026 (Eastern Time). The company received intimation of the completion on October 3, 2026, in accordance with SEBI listing regulations.

headline: Agreements
summary: BGR Energy Systems Limited has entered into a Master Restructuring Agreement with National Asset Reconstruction Company Limited (NARCL) to restructure its outstanding debt of Rs. 3,736 crore. Under the agreement, NARCL will receive 20% equity in the company on a fully diluted basis and up to two nominee directors, with sustainable debt to be repaid within four years by September 2030.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Kothari Petrochemicals Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Chennai Bench, has issued an order regarding its proposed Scheme of Amalgamation. The order directs the companies involved to convene separate meetings of their shareholders and unsecured creditors.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited announced it has received sanction from the Hon'ble NCLT, Chennai Bench for the Scheme of Amalgamation between Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited and Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited. The approval covers the merger and applies to both companies' respective shareholders and creditors.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Kothari Sugars And Chemicals Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal, Chennai Bench, has issued an order regarding its proposed Scheme of Amalgamation. The order directs the companies involved to convene separate meetings of their shareholders and unsecured creditors.

headline: General Updates
summary: Privi Speciality Chemicals Limited has notified the Exchange of a meeting of its equity shareholders regarding a Scheme of Amalgamation. The meeting is scheduled for Tuesday, October 27, 2026, at 12:30 p.m.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: IRM Energy Limited has notified the Exchange of a newspaper publication regarding the hearing notice for its proposed Scheme of Amalgamation. The scheme involves the merger of Enertech Distribution Management Private Limited with IRM Energy Limited and their respective shareholders.

headline: Updates
summary: India Glycols Limited announced the apportionment of the cost of acquisition of equity shares across itself (the demerged company) and two resulting companies, Ennature Bio Pharma Limited and IGL Spirits Limited. This follows a Scheme of Arrangement among the three companies and their shareholders.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: BirlaNu Limited announced that the NCLT Hyderabad Bench has approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of Clean Coats Private Limited (Transferor Company) with BirlaNu Limited (Transferee Company) via order dated October 6, 2026. However, the scheme petition filed by the Transferor Company before the NCLT Mumbai Bench is still pending approval. The scheme will only come into effect upon filing certified copies of the sanctioning orders with the respective Registrar of Companies by both companies.

headline: Press Release
summary: Inox Green Energy Services Limited has completed payment for the transfer of Wind World India's 4.5 GW wind O&M business, in accordance with the Business Transfer Agreement. The company disclosed this via a press release dated October 7, 2026, filed with the stock exchange.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Maharashtra Seamless Limited's Board has approved a composite scheme of arrangement to demerge two of its undertakings into its wholly owned subsidiaries—MSL Seamless Tubes Limited and United Seamless Limited—with an appointed date of October 1, 2026. The scheme, which remains subject to shareholder, creditor, and NCLT approvals, will result in MSTL issuing shares directly to MSL's eligible shareholders as its existing capital is cancelled.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Arisinfra Solutions Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench, has admitted its application for the proposed amalgamation of Arisunitern Re Solutions Private Limited into Arisinfra Solutions Limited. The Tribunal's order is procedural, directing the company to convene meetings of shareholders and secured creditors and to notify certain unsecured creditors and regulators for approval of the scheme. The amalgamation remains subject to shareholder, creditor, and final Tribunal approval.

headline: General Updates
summary: KSS Limited announced that the NCLT, Mumbai Bench, has passed an order dated 28th September 2026 rectifying a typographical error in its earlier approval order dated 5th August 2026, correcting the Interim Resolution Professional's name from "Mr. Manoj Kumar Agarwal" to "Mr. Dharmendra Dhelariya." The rectification, which was sought by Mr. Dhelariya as Chairman of the Monitoring Committee, is confined solely to this name correction and does not alter the approved Resolution Plan, its terms, or any other directions in the original order.

headline: General Updates
summary: GOCL Corporation Limited has received an NCLT order dated October 8, 2026, regarding the proposed merger of Hinduja National Power Corporation Limited into GOCL. The NCLT has directed the company to convene meetings of its equity shareholders and unsecured creditors to consider and approve the scheme.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: The National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Ahmedabad Bench, has sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation involving Kilburn Chemicals Limited and Meghmani Crop Nutrition Limited as transferor companies and Meghmani Organics Limited as the transferee company. The scheme will become effective once the certified NCLT order is received and filed by all companies with the Registrar of Companies, Ahmedabad.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Triveni Power Transmission Ltd (TPTL), a party to the composite scheme of arrangement involving Triveni Engineering & Industries Ltd, has received listing and trading approvals from BSE and NSE for its equity shares effective October 12, 2026. A total of 10,47,54,338 fully paid-up equity shares of Rs. 2/- each will be listed under BSE scrip code 544824 and NSE symbol TRIVENIPT.

company: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited
headline: Demerger
summary: Jubilant Agri and Consumer Products Limited announced that the NCLT Allahabad Bench has issued an order directing notices to statutory and regulatory authorities for their input on its proposed demerger with Jubilant Agri Solutions Limited. The next hearing in the matter is scheduled for December 03, 2026.

headline: Updates
summary: Bhagyanagar India Limited announced that Tieramet Limited, the resulting company from a Composite Scheme of Arrangement, has allotted equity shares to Bhagyanagar India Limited's shareholders. This update was disclosed to the stock exchange as part of the scheme's implementation.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Meghmani Organics Limited has received the NCLT Ahmedabad Bench's certified order approving the scheme of amalgamation of its two wholly owned subsidiaries, Kilburn Chemicals Limited and Meghmani Crop Nutrition Limited, into itself. The scheme will become effective upon filing of the certified order with the Registrar of Companies, Ahmedabad.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Saksoft Limited announced that the NCLT Chennai Bench has issued a rectified order correcting factual and typographical errors in the original order approving its Scheme of Amalgamation with Augmento Labs Private Limited. The corrections clarify Saksoft's role as Transferee Company, the scheme annexure reference, and certain dates, though the tribunal declined to allow additions regarding STPI and GST notices.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: H.G. Infra Engineering Limited has incorporated a Section 8 not-for-profit subsidiary, "H.G. Talent Edge Foundation ITI Bhiwadi," on October 10, 2026, acquiring a 51% stake for Rs. 51,000 in cash. The entity, established to support the PM Setu scheme for upgrading ITIs, is yet to commence operations and will have no material impact on the Company.

headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: Goodluck India Limited's Board has granted in-principle approval to expand its corporate restructuring plan. The expanded scope now includes the amalgamation of its material subsidiary, Goodluck Defence and Aerospace Limited, along with Goodluck Green Energy Limited, into the Company.

headline: General Updates
summary: Veranda Learning Solutions Limited announced the apportionment of the cost of acquisition of its equity shares and those of J.K. Shah Commerce Education Limited, following a Composite Scheme of Arrangement involving Veranda XL Learning Solutions Private Limited. The scheme was implemented under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Emcure Pharmaceuticals Limited's Board approved a scheme to amalgamate its wholly owned subsidiaries, Zuventus Healthcare Limited and Emcutix Biopharmaceuticals Limited, into the holding company. The merger is subject to requisite statutory and regulatory approvals.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: K.M. Sugar Mills Limited has completed the demerger of its Distillery Division into K.M. Spirits and Allied Industries Limited, with the resulting company allotting 1,84,00,034 fully-paid equity shares of INR 10 each to eligible shareholders of K.M. Sugar Mills as of the October 2, 2026 record date. Concurrently, the shares of the resulting company previously held by K.M. Sugar Mills have been cancelled, meaning K.M. Spirits ceases to be a subsidiary of the company.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Ventive Hospitality Limited's board has approved filing an appeal against Point No. 22 of the NCLT Mumbai Bench's September 23, 2026 order concerning its proposed amalgamation with three transferor companies. The company will continue to inform stock exchanges of any material developments regarding the scheme.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited announced that, per NCLT Chennai's order dated September 30, 2026, a meeting of its Unsecured Creditors will be held on November 13, 2026 via video conferencing to consider and approve the Scheme of Amalgamation. Unsecured Creditors on record as of the cut-off date of July 31, 2026 are eligible to vote, with remote e-voting open from November 10 to November 12, 2026.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Kothari Sugars and Chemicals Limited has convened a meeting of its Equity Shareholders on November 13, 2026, via video conferencing, as directed by the Hon'ble NCLT, to consider and approve the Scheme of Amalgamation. The remote e-voting period runs from November 10 to November 12, 2026, with the cut-off date for eligibility fixed as November 6, 2026.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Kothari Petrochemicals Limited has notified the Exchange of a newspaper publication regarding a Joint Notice of Meetings for its Equity Shareholders and Unsecured Creditors. The notice was issued pursuant to an order from the National Company Law Tribunal, Chennai Bench.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Kothari Petrochemicals Limited has announced that, per NCLT Chennai's order dated September 30, 2026, a meeting of its Unsecured Creditors will be held on November 13, 2026 via video conferencing to consider and approve the Scheme of Amalgamation. The cut-off date for e-voting eligibility is July 31, 2026, with remote e-voting open from November 10–12, 2026. The Notice and Explanatory Statement have been sent to creditors and are also available on the company's website.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Kothari Petrochemicals Limited has convened a meeting of its Equity Shareholders on November 13, 2026, via video conferencing to consider and approve a Scheme of Amalgamation, as directed by the Hon'ble NCLT, Chennai Bench. Shareholders on record as of the cut-off date of November 6, 2026, are eligible to vote, with remote e-voting open from November 10 to November 12, 2026. The Notice and Explanatory Statement have been dispatched electronically and are also available on the Company's website.

headline: General Updates
summary: Master Trust Limited has acquired 100% equity shares (5,00,000 shares at Rs. 10 each) of Future Colonizers & Construction Limited for Rs. 50,00,000 in cash, pursuant to an NCLT-approved Resolution Plan dated August 13, 2026. Following this allotment, Future Colonizers & Construction Limited has become a wholly owned subsidiary of Master Trust Limited. The acquisition, in the Construction and Real Estate sector, is aimed at implementing the approved Resolution Plan and realizing the target company's assets.

headline: General Updates
summary: Master Trust Limited announced that Future Colonizers & Construction Limited has allotted 5,00,000 equity shares to it under an NCLT-approved Resolution Plan, making it a wholly owned subsidiary. The acquisition, valued at Rs. 50,00,000 in cash, was approved by the Board on 12th October, 2026.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Orient Cement Limited has notified the exchange of a newspaper publication regarding a Joint Company Petition before the NCLT Ahmedabad Bench. The petition concerns the Scheme of Amalgamation of Orient Cement Limited with Ambuja Cements Limited.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Ambuja Cements Limited has notified the exchange of a newspaper publication regarding a Joint Company Petition before the NCLT Ahmedabad Bench. The petition concerns the Scheme of Amalgamation of Orient Cement Limited with Ambuja Cements Limited.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: ACC Limited has notified the exchange of a newspaper publication regarding the hearing of a joint company petition for its proposed amalgamation with Ambuja Cements Limited. The petition is being heard before the National Company Law Tribunal's Ahmedabad Bench.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Ambuja Cements Limited has notified the exchange of a newspaper publication regarding the hearing of a joint company petition for the Scheme of Amalgamation of ACC Limited into Ambuja Cements Limited. The petition is before the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal, Ahmedabad Bench.

headline: General Updates
summary: Aequs Limited announced that the Office of the Regional Director, South Western Region, has rejected its proposed Scheme of Amalgamation with three transferor companies—AeroStructures Manufacturing India Private Limited, Aequs Engineered Plastics Private Limited, and Aequs Force Consumer Products Private Limited. The scheme was filed under Section 233 of the Companies Act, 2013.

headline: General Updates
summary: The NCLT Ahmedabad Bench has approved a rectification of the Appointed Date for Share India Securities Limited's Scheme, changing it from October 1, 2023 to April 1, 2026, via an order pronounced on October 12, 2026.

headline: Updates
summary: HEG Advanced Materials Limited announced that HEG Graphite Limited, the resulting company under a composite scheme of arrangement, has officially changed its name to HEG Limited effective October 12, 2026, as approved by the Registrar of Companies. The company requested that this information be taken on record and disclosed to the BSE and National Stock Exchange of India.

headline: General Updates
summary: JSW Energy Limited has received the certified copy of the order sanctioning the Scheme of Arrangement between GE Power India Limited (demerged company) and itself (resulting company). The scheme was approved under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013.

headline: General Updates
summary: GE Power India Limited has received the certified copy of the NCLT order dated October 1, 2026, sanctioning the Scheme of Arrangement for the demerger of its Durgapur facility undertaking into JSW Energy Limited. The company will separately notify the stock exchanges of the Effective Date and Record Date in due course.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Blue Star Limited announced that its step-down subsidiary, Blue Star Air Conditioning & Refrigeration (U) Limited in Uganda, will undergo a voluntary strike-off following approval by the board of Blue Star International FZCO. The subsidiary, incorporated in June 2023, has never commenced business and is expected to be struck off by March 31, 2027, after which it will cease to be a subsidiary of the company.

headline: Demerger
summary: Brooks Laboratories Limited's Board has approved a scheme to demerge its Manufacturing Business into wholly-owned subsidiary Abridge Speciality Limited on a going-concern basis. The demerged undertaking accounted for ~96.66% of the company's FY2026 turnover (Rs. 8,287.26 lakhs), and the scheme requires approvals from stock exchanges, SEBI, NCLT, and shareholders/creditors. Upon effectiveness, the resulting company will be renamed Brooks Laboratories Limited, while the demerged company will become Xuri Lifesciences Limited.

headline: News Verification
summary: The Exchange has asked IDBI Bank for clarification regarding a news report claiming the Cabinet approved a stake sale to Fairfax for Rs 52,878 crore. IDBI Bank has not yet responded to the query.

headline: General Updates
summary: Bajaj Healthcare Limited announced that the Hon'ble NCLT, Mumbai Bench, has approved its acquisition of Genrx Pharmaceuticals Private Limited (in Liquidation) on a going concern basis via order dated October 13, 2026. The company's trading window will continue to remain closed for all designated persons and their immediate relatives.

headline: General Updates
summary: Smartworks Coworking Spaces Limited has notified the Exchange that it has e-filed Form RSC-1 with the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal for a reduction of share capital (Securities Premium Account). This filing initiates the regulatory process for the proposed capital reduction.

headline: General Updates
summary: The Government of India has approved the strategic sale of a 60.72% stake in IDBI Bank Ltd. to M/s 10955230 Canada Inc. (parent entity Fairfax Financial Holdings Ltd.) for a consideration of approximately Rs. 52,878 crore. The transaction, comprising GoI's 30.48% and LIC's 30.24% shareholding, was finalized through a two-stage competitive bidding process following CCEA approval on 14/10/2026.

headline: News Verification
summary: IDBI Bank Limited issued a response to a stock exchange clarification request regarding a news report claiming the Cabinet approved a stake sale to Fairfax for Rs 52,878 crore. The company's reply is attached to the announcement.

headline: News Verification
summary: The Exchange has asked CSB Bank for clarification regarding a news report suggesting a possible merger with IDBI Bank after a Fairfax deal. CSB Bank's response is still awaited.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Tata Communications' Board approved transferring its entire shareholding in Kaleyra, Inc. to wholly-owned subsidiary Tata Communications (Netherlands) B.V., in exchange for newly issued TCNL shares at fair market value, simplifying the group structure without changing ultimate ownership. The Board also approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026, with an unmodified limited review opinion from its auditors, and appointed Ms. Ridhi Sood as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective November 1, 2026.

headline: Updates
summary: HEG Advanced Materials Limited informed the Exchange that the GST Authority has dropped proceedings against it for FY 2020-21. The intimation was made by the Resulting Company under the Composite Scheme of Arrangement.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Tata Steel Limited has received the certified true copy of the NCLT Mumbai Bench order approving the Scheme of Amalgamation of Rujuvalika Investments Limited with Tata Steel Limited. The order relates to the merger of the two companies and their respective shareholders.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Asian Energy Services Limited has received the certified true copy of the final order from the NCLT Mumbai Bench approving the Scheme of Merger by Absorption of Oilmax Energy Private Limited into Asian Energy Services Limited. The scheme also covers the respective shareholders of both companies.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: The Phoenix Mills Limited announced that its step-down subsidiary, Truevalue Infrabuild Private Limited, will amalgamate into its subsidiary, SGH Realty Private Limited, following board approvals on October 15, 2026. The merger is subject to approvals from the Regional Director/NCLT and other statutory authorities, and aims to create a simplified and unified business structure.

headline: News Verification
summary: CSB Bank Limited issued a response to a stock exchange clarification regarding a news report suggesting a possible merger with IDBI Bank after a Fairfax deal. The company's reply is attached to the announcement.

headline: General Updates
summary: REC Limited has received a No Objection Certificate from the RBI dated October 15, 2026, subject to specified conditions. The scheme remains contingent on further statutory and regulatory approvals, including shareholder and creditor consent.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Power Finance Corporation Limited has received a No Objection Certificate from the Reserve Bank of India regarding the proposed merger of REC Limited into PFC. The scheme, which also involves their respective shareholders and creditors, will proceed under sections 230-232 of the Companies Act, 2013.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Balkrishna Paper Mills Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT) has admitted its petition for a Scheme of Arrangement involving the reduction of its share capital under Sections 66 and 52 of the Companies Act, 2013. The company has been directed to comply with the necessary directions in the NCLT order dated October 14, 2026. The reduction involves adjusting accumulated losses of approximately Rs. 52.28 crore against the Securities Premium Reserve and reducing the face value of equity shares from Rs. 10 to Re. 1 each.

headline: Updates
summary: Affle 3i Limited announced that the Supreme Court of India has granted a stay order on the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) proceedings of Bobble, which were pending before the NCLT. This stay provides temporary relief by halting the insolvency proceedings against Bobble.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Hindware Home Innovation Limited has notified the exchange of a Scheme of Arrangement under SEBI Regulation 30. The disclosure follows an NCLT order approving the scheme.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: GFL Limited has received the certified true copy of the NCLT's final order regarding its Scheme of Arrangement, following the tribunal's hearing on September 28, 2026. The Scheme's appointed date is April 1, 2026.

headline: General Updates
summary: RBL Bank has received RBI approval dated October 16, 2026, sanctioning the amalgamation of Emirates NBD Bank P.J.S.C.'s Indian branches into RBL Bank. The amalgamation will take effect on December 1, 2026, when all Indian branches of Emirates NBD Bank will operate as branches of RBL Bank.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: JSW Steel Limited announced that the Hon'ble National Company Law Tribunal has approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of Piombino Steel Limited with JSW Steel Limited. The order, sanctioned under Sections 230 to 232 of the Companies Act, 2013, covers the merger and its respective shareholders.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Balkrishna Paper Mills Limited has published a Notice in Form RSC 4 in Business Standard and Navshakti (Marathi) newspapers on October 17, 2026, regarding a petition admitted before the National Company Law Tribunal, Mumbai Bench, for reduction of the company's share capital. The announcement was made pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, and the newspaper clippings are also available on the company's website at www.bpml.in.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: EPL Limited has received observation letters from both BSE and NSE regarding the Scheme of Amalgamation of Indovida India Private Limited with the company and their respective shareholders. This marks a regulatory step forward in the amalgamation process.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: CL Educate Limited has announced a scheme of amalgamation whereby DEXIT Global Limited, its wholly-owned subsidiary, will merge into the company. The merger is intended to consolidate businesses, streamline operations, achieve economies of scale, and unlock synergies across products, customers, and technology. As DEXIT is wholly owned, no new shares will be issued and the transaction is exempt from related party transaction requirements.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Power Finance Corporation Limited announced that it has received No Objection letters from BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited regarding the proposed scheme of merger of REC Limited into Power Finance Corporation. The merger will involve REC Limited as the transferor company amalgamating with and into PFC as the transferee company.

headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: GOCL Corporation's Board approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, accompanied by the auditors' Limited Review Reports. The Board also noted the NCLT order directing meetings of equity shareholders and unsecured creditors regarding the proposed merger of Hinduja National Power Corporation Limited into GOCL, with those meetings scheduled for November 24, 2026 via video conferencing.

headline: Other Restructuring
summary: Puravankara Limited has incorporated Burgundyprime Realty Private Limited as a wholly owned subsidiary on 19th October 2026, subscribing to 9,999 equity shares at ₹10 each for a total of ₹99,990. The new entity, registered in India within the real estate industry, was formed to carry on real estate development activities.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: REC Limited has received No Objection Letters from BSE and NSE dated October 19, 2026, for its proposed scheme of merger with Power Finance Corporation Limited. The scheme remains subject to shareholder and creditor approval, RBI approval, and other statutory and regulatory conditions.

headline: Record Date
summary: Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited announced that its Scheme of Amalgamation with Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited has been sanctioned by the NCLT and will become effective November 1, 2026, with an appointed date of April 1, 2026. The Board approved the resulting increase in authorized share capital from ₹90 crore to ₹110 crore following the merger of the transferor company's reclassified capital. Additionally, November 18, 2026 has been fixed as the record date for allotting consideration shares at a ratio of 23 equity shares of the transferee company for every 2 shares held in the transferor company.

headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: Dr. Agarwal's Health Care Limited's Board approved the Scheme of Amalgamation with Dr. Agarwal's Eye Hospital Limited, effective November 1, 2026 (appointed date April 1, 2026), following NCLT sanction and ROC filing. The authorized share capital will increase from ₹90 crore to ₹110 crore through reclassification and merger of the transferor company's capital. A record date of November 18, 2026 has been fixed for allotting consideration shares at a ratio of 23 equity shares of the transferee company for every 2 shares held in the transferor company.

headline: Sale or disposal
summary: Eternal Limited's board approved transferring its Going-out India business to wholly owned subsidiary Zomato Entertainment Private Limited via slump sale as part of an internal restructuring to consolidate the business and achieve operational synergies. The board also approved a share swap with Mygate involving the transfer of its Adonmo shares in exchange for Mygate shares, a step toward the proposed Adonmo-Mygate merger, after which Eternal will hold ~4.4% of the merged entity (valued at INR 156 crore versus its INR 112 crore investment). Additionally, the board approved unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026.

headline: Disclosure of material issue
summary: P. E. Analytics Limited has filed an application under Section 97(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 before the Hon'ble NCLT concerning the Annual General Meeting of its material subsidiary. The company disclosed this as a material issue in its corporate announcement.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: GOCL Corporation Limited has scheduled a meeting of its equity shareholders on November 24, 2026, to be held via video conferencing, as directed by the NCLT, to consider approval of a Scheme of Merger by Absorption of Hinduja National Power Corporation Limited into GOCL. The company has appointed KFin Technologies Limited to provide remote e-voting facilities from November 19 to November 23, 2026, with a cut-off date of November 17, 2026. The Notice and Explanatory Statement have been sent electronically to shareholders and are also available on the company's website.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: The NCLT Kolkata has approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of Shree Venkateshwara Electrocast Private Limited with Shyam Sel and Power Limited, a wholly owned subsidiary of Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited. The scheme will become effective upon filing of the certified NCLT order with the Registrar of Companies, West Bengal.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Ugro Capital Limited announced that, in compliance with a National Company Law Tribunal order regarding its merger scheme, it will issue notices to statutory authorities under Section 230(5) of the Companies Act, 2013, inviting representations within 30 days. The company must also publish hearing notices in Business Standard and Navshakti at least 10 days before the hearing and host the scheme documents on its website. Authorities failing to respond within the stipulated period will be presumed to have no representations to make on the proposed amalgamation.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Jindal Stainless Limited's Board approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half-year ended September 30, 2026. The Board also approved a draft scheme of amalgamation of the company with its wholly owned subsidiaries—Chromeni Steels Limited, Rabirun Vinimay Private Limited, JSL Super Steel Limited, and Jindal United Steel Limited—with an appointed date of April 1, 2027, subject to shareholder, creditor, regulatory, and NCLT approvals.

headline: Suspension of Trading
summary: Trading in Talwalkars Better Value Fitness Limited equity shares will remain suspended due to a Reduction of Share Capital ordered by the NCLT. The suspension follows the company's compliance with the tribunal's directive.

headline: Suspension of Trading
summary: Trading in Ashapura Intimates Fashion Limited's equity shares will remain suspended due to a Reduction of Share Capital ordered by the NCLT. The suspension follows the tribunal's order implementing the capital reduction.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Siemens Limited has published a newspaper notice regarding the final hearing of the company scheme petition for the amalgamation of Siemens Rail Automation Private Limited with Siemens Limited and their respective shareholders. The announcement serves as a copy of that newspaper publication.

headline: Press Release
summary: Heritage Foods Limited has notified the Exchange of a press release dated October 23, 2026, regarding the amalgamation of its wholly owned subsidiary, Heritage Novandie Foods Limited, with the parent company. The announcement confirms the merger of the subsidiary into Heritage Foods Limited.

headline: Outcome of Board Meeting
summary: Heritage Foods Limited's Board has approved a scheme to amalgamate its wholly-owned subsidiary, Heritage Novandie Foods Limited, into the company under Sections 230-232 of the Companies Act, 2013. The amalgamation is subject to approval from the National Company Law Tribunal, shareholders, and other authorities, with the draft scheme to be filed with stock exchanges in due course. The move is intended to achieve greater integration of businesses and financial resources.

headline: Press Release
summary: Shyam Metalics and Energy Limited announced that its subsidiary, Shyam Sel and Power Limited, has received NCLT approval for the merger of Shree Venkateshwara Electrocast Private Limited. The merger is effective retroactively from April 1, 2024.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Newgen Software Technologies Limited announced Exchange approval of a Scheme of Arrangement for the amalgamation of Newgen Computers Technologies Limited (the Transferor Company) into Newgen Software Technologies Limited (the Transferee Company). The scheme covers the respective shareholders and creditors of both entities.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Network18 Media & Investments Limited announced an update regarding the Scheme of Amalgamation of its wholly-owned subsidiary, News18 Marathi Private Limited, with the Company. The disclosure was made under Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015.

headline: General Updates
summary: Arisinfra Solutions Limited has notified the Exchange of an NCLT-convened meeting of its Secured Creditors scheduled for November 25, 2026. The announcement was filed as a general update regarding the meeting notice.

headline: Shareholders meeting
summary: Arisinfra Solutions Limited has notified the Exchange of an NCLT-convened meeting of its equity shareholders scheduled for November 25, 2026. The meeting notice has been issued to shareholders in accordance with the tribunal's directions.

headline: Copy of Newspaper Publication
summary: Arisinfra Solutions Limited has published newspaper advertisements regarding Meetings of its Equity Shareholders and Secured Creditors scheduled for November 25, 2026, to be held via video conferencing, in compliance with SEBI regulations. The advertisements appeared in Financial Express (English) and Loksatta (Marathi) on October 24, 2026, with notices dispatched to shareholders and creditors on October 23, 2026. Copies of the advertisements are also available on the Company's website.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Ugro Capital Limited has published newspaper advertisements in Business Standard (English) and Navshakti (Marathi) on 24th October 2026 regarding a notice of hearing for its amalgamation/merger petition, scheduled for 20th November 2026. The announcement was made pursuant to SEBI Listing Regulations and informs shareholders and the public about the upcoming court hearing in connection with the Scheme.

headline: Updates
summary: Arihant Academy Limited has approved the acquisition of the entire businesses of M/s Arihant Tutorials and M/s Rajguru Academy on a going concern basis through slump sale. The company disclosed this investment approval to the Exchange.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Samvardhana Motherson International Limited announced that the National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), Mumbai Bench-II, has sanctioned a Scheme of Arrangement involving Samvardhana Motherson Auto System Private Limited, Motherson Machinery and Automations Limited, Samvardhana Motherson Innovative Solutions Limited, and Samvardhana Motherson International Limited. The scheme, approved by the respective boards on 07.02.2025 with an appointed date of 01.04.2024, provides for the amalgamation and demerger of the petitioner companies into Samvardhana Motherson International Limited.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Mankind Pharma's Board approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. It also approved a scheme of amalgamation merging two wholly owned subsidiaries, Prolijune Lifesciences and Pavi Buildwell, into the company (appointed date April 1, 2027), and noted a separate scheme merging step-down subsidiary Upakarma Ayurveda into Mankind Consumer Products. Both schemes remain subject to statutory and regulatory approvals, including from the NCLT.

headline: Scheme of Arrangement
summary: Mankind Pharma's Board approved its unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. It also approved a scheme of amalgamation merging two wholly owned subsidiaries, Prolijune Lifesciences and Pavi Buildwell, into the company with an appointed date of April 1, 2027, and noted a separate scheme merging step-down subsidiary Upakarma Ayurveda into Mankind Consumer Products. Both schemes remain subject to statutory and regulatory approvals, including from the NCLT.

headline: Amalgamation/Merger
summary: Avantel Limited's Board approved the merger of its wholly owned subsidiary, Imeds Global Private Limited, into the company, subject to NCLT Amaravati Bench sanction and other regulatory approvals. The Board also appointed Mr. Nimmagadda Sreenivasa Rao as an Additional Director designated as Director (Technical) for a three-year term starting October 26, 2026, subject to shareholder approval via postal ballot.

headline: General Updates
summary: LEAP India Limited announced that its wholly owned subsidiaries, Vimprotech Private Limited and Total Integrated Packaging Solutions Private Limited, have executed Business Transfer Agreements on October 26, 2026 to acquire the business undertakings of Vimprotech (a sole proprietorship) and TIPS (a partnership firm) on a slump sale basis as going concerns. The acquisitions are intended to support LEAP's growth strategy through backward integration, strengthening its design capabilities and expanding its vacuum-formed, thermoformed, and injection-moulded packaging portfolio. The transactions are not related party transactions, and the necessary SEBI disclosures and a press release are enclosed as annexures.

headline: Demerger
summary: The NCLT Mumbai Bench has scheduled November 27, 2026 as the final hearing date for EFC (I) Limited's demerger petition, per an order dated October 22, 2026. The company will comply with the tribunal's directions, and the Scheme of Arrangement remains subject to applicable regulatory and other approvals.

headline: General Updates
summary: Share India Securities Limited has received certified copies of the NCLT Ahmedabad Bench-I Rectification Order dated 12.10.2026 and the Scheme of Amalgamation of Silverleaf Capital Services Private Limited with the Company. The announcement was made as a general update to inform stakeholders of the regulatory documentation received.
